summary.text: Linda Holmes has represented the 42nd District in the Illinois Senate since 2007, and the legislature biography says she was elected to the Senate in 2006.

paragraphs.text: She received a bachelor's degree from the National College of Education (now National-Lewis University) and a Doctor of Humane Letters from Aurora University.
According to the biography, she was the first woman president of the National Association of the Remodeling Industry.
